description: This file defines an abstract class CacheManagerImpl that manages caching mechanisms using Infinispan, including initialization of TreeCache objects and integration with VendorCacheManager.

classes.name: CacheManagerImpl
classes.description: An abstract class responsible for managing cache initialization and retrieval using Infinispan.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the cache with the specified cache name, setting up TreeCache and starting the cache.

methods.name: getManager
methods.description: Returns the Infinispan EmbeddedCacheManager instance from VendorCacheManager.
